name: Ore o Ijimeta Ano Onna o Wakarase ~Saimin Tsukaware Buzama Sarashite Ahegao Dogeza no Honki Shazai~
original_name: オレを虐めたあの女をわからせ ～催眠使われ無様晒してアヘ顔土下座の本気謝罪～
source:
Let the woman who bullied me know how it feels. Apologizing Ahegao Prostration after being exposed to hypnosis

A hypnosis app reversed the situation... I tried to get the woman who bullied me to apologize, but she showed no signs of apologizing. If that's the case, then until you apologize, I'll do whatever I want.

[From DLSite]
translation:
让那个欺负我的女人知道她的感受。接受催眠后向阿赫高跪拜道歉

催眠应用程序扭转了局面……我试图让欺负我的女人道歉，但她没有任何道歉的迹象。既然如此，那么在你道歉之前，我会做任何我想做的事。

[来自DL网站]
